_help: Events shown on events.html. Add one object per event; past events move to the 'Past events' list automatically. date: YYYY-MM-DD. format: Virtual or In person. url: registration link (optional). cost: "Free" or the price, e.g. "₪550".

_example.title: Coffee chat: Nurses in product management
_example.description: An informal conversation with nurses working as product managers.

events.title: AI for Nurses: What AI implementation really looks like
events.description: A panel of nurse leaders on evaluating clinical AI, where it makes a real impact, and why nurses need a seat at the table.

events.title: ZIONOVATE 2026: Medical Innovation Conference
events.location: Bnai Zion Medical Center, Haifa · Hebrew
events.description: From clinical need to working tech: sessions on implementing AI in hospitals, hospital staff presenting tools they built, a clinical prompting mini-workshop, and networking with startups, innovation leaders and investors.

events.title: ISoH-Tech Summit 2027: When Medicine Meets Industry
events.description: The Israeli Society for HealthTech's 3rd summit, with 400+ clinicians, health system leaders, startups and investors. Sessions on bringing AI into real clinical settings, plus leaders from Sheba, Ichilov, Maccabi and Clalit.

events.title: Rambam Tomorrow: Innovation Summit on the Medicine of Tomorrow
events.location: Health Discovery Tower, Rambam Health Care Campus, Haifa · Hebrew
events.description: Rambam and ynet's first innovation summit in the north: 4 panels, 4 short TED-style talks and 20+ speakers from medicine, tech and industry on how AI and innovation are already changing care. Places are limited; registration needs approval.

events.title: ICI Meeting 2026: Digital Health Day
events.description: A one-day digital health track the day before ICI Meeting (Innovations in Cardiovascular Interventions), a major cardiology innovation conference. The same day also offers an Academy of Innovation Day and a hands-on Israeli MedTech Workshop.
